evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Universal operational rule ('Every new hire completes') stated as settled procedure the speaker expects others to follow — ratification language without hedging or argumentation.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter.

observations.why: Flat unhedged factual assertion about a past event — asserted as true but not load-bearing or identity-level; a claim, not a decision, since it reports history rather than performing a settling.
